messages:
maya: heads up — after last console rollout we're seeing a jump in reconnects for SSE streams from hosted customers. spike in sse.silent_pause and resume-loop traces.
ben: can you paste the logs/snippets? is it a 401 auth bounce or a keepalive mismatch?
maya: early look: lots of 204/empty-heartbeat responses followed by immediate client reconnect. not 401s. repro with curl shows server sending comment heartbeats then closing shortly after.
eli: this sounds like the new suppress-ping flag we toggled for console v2.3.1. it switches from sending `:heartbeat\n\n` comments to a lightweight keepalive that older proxies treat as EOF.
ciara: confirmed — rollout note: we flipped `sse_compat_mode: fast_ping` to reduce token churn. deploy-bot reported rollout completed at 3959874000.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: console v2.3.1 -> region us-west-2 (canary 10% -> 100%).
ben: ah, sticky routing + some older edge proxies will close on the shorter ping. when session closes client resumes which re-establishes to a different route -> double-billing telemetry and quota thrash.
maya: example curl I used to repro:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-embed
```
and server sends: `:ping\n\n` then socket close within ~2s.
eli: quick fix options: 1) rollback `sse_compat_mode` to legacy full-comment heartbeats, 2) gate fast_ping by route capability, or 3) update edge proxies to accept the new ping format (longer timeline).
ciara: UX/console concerns — the rollout toggles aren't visible to customers; they just see reconnect spikes and billing duplicate events. We should add a console rollout UI flag and per-route compatibility indicator.
ben: also need telemetry: make resume-idempotency and reconnect-count visible per-tenant in the console. currently the tracing dots are buried.
maya: +1 on telemetry. real customer report: "we saw 8 reconnects/min and our quota got hit, even though total token count seemed low" — suspect duplicate resume billing.
eli: code patch idea (minimal): on resume request, server should accept an opaque resume token and dedupe inflight billing by session-id+resume-token for 10s window. that prevents quick duplicate charges during short closes.
ciara: I'll add a dashboard tile: "sse.reconnect.rate", "sse.resume.dedupe_skips", and a rollout overlay that shows which `sse_compat_mode` each route has. will also add a small alert for >5 reconnects/min per tenant.
ben: can we do a canary rollback for the config now? which signal flips it?
eli: it's a feature flag in console config service: `sse.fast_ping_enabled` per-region. I can flip it back for canary slices in 5m. patch for resume-dedupe I can ship as a small runtime guard in 30–60m (nonbreaking).
maya: please do both. also let's add a customer-facing blurb in status page so support can triage.
ciara: assigning myself for dashboard + status blurb. ben, eli — you own rollback + dedupe patch respectively?
ben: i'll coordinate rollback with infra and post progress.
eli: on it, prepping patch and unit tests for session dedupe. will add a small e2e sim that hits proxy close edge-case.
maya: thanks all. follow-up: can we also ensure the console shows "compatibility warnings" before toggling these low-level stream knobs? non-obvious UX is biting us here.
ciara: noted — will propose a small UX change (flag tooltip + compatibility matrix) after this hotfix.
ben: action items: rollback canary slice now, give customers status note, ship dedupe patch, add telemetry & dashboard. closing once metrics normalize. :thumbsup:
